name: Juncosa (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with a black ploughshare surrounded by two green olive branches.
history: The official flag of Juncosa is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with the black ploughshare of the arms in the middle, of height 7/9 of the height of the cloth and surrounded by two green olive branches; the branches are an external ornament of the arms included on the flag for the importance of olives in the local economy. Approved on 30 July 1991 and published in the DOGC on 9 August 1991.

features.role: two olive branches surrounding the ploughshare
